column8: note
Authority or combined shutdown failure becomes a nonzero executable result and final success is suppressed; exact Go signal-to-exit-code breadth remains open.
Concurrent authenticated connection lifecycle is retained through drain; complete Go connection-attribute behavior remains open.
Admission stops before bounded drain, but the complete Go health endpoint and status transition contract remains open.
One listener and fixed worker pool are owned explicitly; complete Go listener reinitialization behavior remains open.
Repeated shutdown requests are idempotent and stop admission; the full Go shutdown-flag surface remains open.
Shutdown stops admission before worker drain; the exact Go callback and health-publication order remains open.
Accepted, active, completed, and failed connection counts balance after graceful or forced drain; complete per-user limit behavior remains open.
Malformed framing and queued receiver death release socket and connection leases exactly once; the full historical issue matrix remains open.
Handshake failure is contained by the same RAII connection lifecycle; complete Go handshake capability and compatibility behavior remains open.
COM_QUERY, ping, quit, cancellation, and worker failure are bounded by the fixed pool; the complete Go command-dispatch matrix remains open.
Protocol 4.1 connection lifecycle survives concurrent drain; full capability-sensitive dispatch parity remains open.
Connection cleanup remains exact when a command terminates early; complete zero-value query-end semantics remain open.
Connection timeout is bounded and shutdown grace is published, but the complete Go session-variable wait-timeout behavior remains open.
Forced shutdown cancels an in-flight COM_QUERY before joining its worker; full statement timeout and kill semantics remain open.
Shutdown stops admission, cancels active queries, force-closes after grace, and joins every worker; complete Go shutdown breadth remains open.
Every worker join and process-authority stage is attempted before return; transaction commit wait-group behavior is not implemented.
Connection ownership remains exact across authentication failure, but complete auth-plugin handling remains open.
Connection ownership remains exact across authentication lifecycle, but COM_CHANGE_USER and reauthentication remain open.
Connection ownership remains exact across authentication failure, but the complete second-plugin matrix remains open.
Packet framing failure releases connection state exactly once; the complete Go max-allowed-packet boundary matrix remains open.
Connection teardown is exact after framed responses, but complete EOF deprecation and capability behavior remains open.
Connection and query identities remain available through concurrent execution and shutdown; complete process-info behavior remains open.
RAII socket registration, receiver-drop cleanup, cancellation, forced close, and join are covered; complete Go close behavior remains open.
Exact connection lifecycle counters are emitted after drain; complete Go metrics labels and aggregation remain open.
Workers drain before RegionCache, TiKV, and PD shutdown, with combined failures retained and final success ordered last; broad graceful-shutdown integration remains open.
Queued, active, failed, and forced connection paths release their registrations and leases; broader Go leak detection remains open.
Connection counters balance after concurrent graceful and forced drain; complete Go per-status and per-user counting remains open.
